messages:
mara: Quick proposal: for the v1->v2 migration let's surface an "invoice origin" breakdown in Console and on invoices for 30 days before we change billed-as behavior. want rapid feedback.
jonathan: Yes. customers will panic if their invoice suddenly shows different line items. best if invoices show two columns: billed_as and origin_as.
ash: Tech-wise we can annotate usage pings with header `X-RW-Origin-Version: v1` when router auto-routes. billing pipeline can store origin_version for 30d TTL.
sam: Also watch quotas: if routed calls decrement v2 quota customers could hit unexpected limits. propose "quota shadowing" during pilot: routed calls decrement runtime v2 counters but reflect to v1 quota in the Console preview.
anna-ux: UI idea: invoice rows have chevron -> expand panel showing origin breakdown + link to Route Preview. Route Preview modal shows 7d sample, est token delta, est $ delta, and a compatibility score (0-100).
billingsys: For accounting we need a CSV export that includes origin_version and routed_version per-day per-tenant so finance can reconcile. also add `billing.estimated_delta` metric.
mara: Retention/legal: origin_version should be non-PII, retention TTL 30d, opt-in for external tenants; internal tenants default opt-in.
jonathan: Routing precedence: respect explicit `prefer_version` header -> console pin -> auto-route. document in router config and add unit tests.
nash: Metrics to emit: `routing.origin_visible_count`, `routing.routed_token_delta`, `routing.quota_conflicts`. add alert when quota_conflicts > 3 tenants in 1h.
sam: Rollout plan: dry-run preview (no billing) -> invoice-expand pilot (internal tenants) -> 10 external opt-ins -> full 30-day dual-reporting window -> evaluate and flip billed_as if acceptable. automatic rollback on invoice disputes or >0.3% support tickets.
anna-ux: Modal microcopy: "Preview how this route will appear on invoices if routed to v2. Expand a line to see origin breakdown." keep friendly.
mara: Action items: (1) infra add header + metrics (ash) (2) billing ingest origin_version + CSV export (sam) (3) UX invoice expand + route modal (anna-ux) (4) runbook for disputes (jonathan). aim: preview internal dry-run by Wed EOD.
ash: One more: make sure header is added as late as possible in the proxy chain so cached rewrites don't drop it. integration test time.
deploy-bot: (system) scheduled job queued: invoice-origin-pilot-4167890123 -> will post results here.
